scope: Profiler v2 and report presentation source plus public synthetic tests only. No real profiler execution, model loading, hidden observations, predictions, scores or labels accessed. No frozen MF05/addon/completion-runner changes.
fixed_provenance_findings: Arbitrary completion file replaced by exact authorized root COMPLETE status/destinations and root-plan SHA binding.
Requested full/partial METHODS seal anchored to successful pipeline, source generation and protocol identities; rehashed replacement model rejected.
Root deadline may not exceed frozen technical deadline; remaining time caps sampling budget.
measurement_truth: Only pinned 176 known archive population, eligible complete-feature rows; label presence asserted but outcomes never used for sample or timing.
At most16 hash-ordered prefix IDs per seed/config, deterministic and input-order invariant; same sample only when eligible inventories match.
One untimed warmup per fitted model; head predict includes own matrix/estimator preprocessing. Matrix prep also separately timed.
Source extraction timings come from existing cached feature records; source+head is reconstructed eager serial path, excludes rules, not live end-to-end.
No provider/pretrained feature-model inference, fitting, thresholds, decisions or probabilities saved. Existing trained heads are evaluated deliberately.
No per-model memory claim; UNKNOWN timings/partial coverage stay explicit.
Report maps final selected configuration per seed and shows measured count, missing seed/cost UNKNOWN; final TRAIN head costs are not all nested-CV fold costs.
limits: 300 seconds is an explicitly cooperative soft budget checked between calls, capped by original global deadline. Individual joblib load/predict can overrun the last check. Caller must enforce an owned-process hard timeout for strict maximum; this review does not claim hard interruption.
Manual archive-only profiler run is allowed only after completed authorized transaction and before original global deadline, and is not part of completion runner.
Profiler v1 and pre-final protocol preserved; reviewed protocol-v2 exact pins recorded.
